dataSize.help:
Determine data size for a set of data in a certain range.
Example: { dataSize:"blog.posts", keyPattern:{x:1}, min:{x:10}, max:{x:55} }
{min} and {max} parameters are optional. They must either both be included or both omitted.
{keyPattern} is an optional parameter indicating an index pattern that would be useful for iterating over the min/max bounds.
If keyPattern is omitted, it is inferred from the structure of min.
Note: This command may take a while to run.

              maxSize: <try to keep a batch withing maxSize of docs (bytes)>,

              maxDocsPerBatch: <max number of docs/batch>
              maxBytesPerBatch: <try to keep a batch within max bytes/batch>

to check a collection.

killAllSessions.help: kill all logical sessions, for a user, and their operations

killCursors.help: Kill a list of cursor ids

killSessions.help: kill a logical session and its operations

listDatabases.help:

list databases on this server

listDatabasesForAllTenants.help:

command which lists databases for all tenants on this server

lockInfo.help: show all lock info on the server

mapReduce.help: Runs the mapReduce command. See http://dochub.mongodb.org/core/mapreduce for details.

mergeChunks.help:
Internal command to merge a contiguous range of chunks.
Usage: { mergeChunks: <ns>, epoch: <epoch>, bounds: [<min key>, <max key>] }

ping.help: a way to check that the server is alive. responds immediately even if server is in a db lock.

planCacheClear.help: Drops one or all plan cache entries in a collection.

planCacheClearFilters.help: Clears index filter for a single query shape or, if the query shape is omitted, all filters for the collection.

planCacheListFilters.help: Displays index filters for all query shapes in a collection.

planCacheSetFilter.help: Sets index filter for a query shape. Overrides existing filter.

prepareTransaction.help: Prepares a transaction on this shard; sent by a router or re-sent by the transaction commit coordinator for a cross-shard transaction

profile.help: controls the behaviour of the performance profiler, the fraction of eligible operations which are sampled for logging/profiling, and the threshold duration at which ops become eligible. See http://docs.mongodb.org/manual/reference/command/profile

reIndex.help: re-index a collection (can only be run on a standalone mongod)

recipientForgetMigration.help: Interrupts tenant migration data sync and marks that the recipient's durable state machine may be garbage collected.

recipientSyncData.help: Internal replica set command; instructs the recipient to sync data as part of a tenant migration.

recipientVoteImportedFiles.help: An internal mongod command to track which members have imported all donated files during a tenant migration

refreshSessions.help: renew a set of logical sessions

replSetAbortPrimaryCatchUp.help:
{ CmdReplSetAbortPrimaryCatchUp : 1 }
Abort primary catch-up mode; immediately finish the transition to primary without fetching any further unreplicated writes from any other online nodes

replSetFreeze.help:
{ replSetFreeze : <seconds> }
'freeze' state of member to the extent we can do that.  What this really means is that
this node will not attempt to become primary until the time period specified expires.
You can call again with {replSetFreeze:0} to unfreeze sooner.
A process restart unfreezes the member also.
http://dochub.mongodb.org/core/replicasetcommands

replSetGetConfig.help:
Returns the current replica set configuration{ replSetGetConfig : 1 }
http://dochub.mongodb.org/core/replicasetcommands

replSetMaintenance.help:
{ replSetMaintenance : bool }
Enable or disable maintenance mode.

replSetResizeOplog.help: Resize oplog using size (in MBs) and optionally, retention (in terms of hours)

replSetStepDown.help:
{ replSetStepDown : <seconds> }
Step down as primary.  Will not try to reelect self for the specified time period (1 minute if no numeric secs value specified, or secs is 0).
(If another member with same priority takes over in the meantime, it will stay primary.)
http://dochub.mongodb.org/core/replicasetcommands

replSetSyncFrom.help:
{ replSetSyncFrom : "host:port" }
Change who this member is syncing from. Note: This will interrupt and restart an in-progress initial sync.

rotateCertificates.help: Rotate certificates for new SSL connections

saslContinue.help: Subsequent steps in a SASL authentication conversation.

saslStart.help: First step in a SASL authentication conversation.

serverStatus.help: returns lots of administrative server statistics. Optionally set {..., all: 1} to retrieve all server status sections.

setChangeStreamState.help:
Sets the change stream state in the serverless

setClusterParameter.help: Set cluster parameter on replica set or node

setDefaultRWConcern.help: set the current read/write concern defaults (cluster-wide)

setFeatureCompatibilityVersion.help: Set the featureCompatibilityVersion used by this cluster. If set to '6.0', then features introduced in versions greater than '6.0' will be disabled If set to '6.3', then features introduced in '7.0' will be disabled. If set to '7.0', then '7.0' features are enabled, and all nodes in the cluster must be binary version 7.0. See https://docs.mongodb.com/master/release-notes/6.0-compatibility/#feature-compatibility.

setIndexCommitQuorum.help:
Resets the commitQuorum for the given index builds in a collection. Usage:
{
    setIndexCommitQuorum: <string> collection name,
    indexNames: array<string> list of index names,
    commitQuorum: <string|number|object> option to define the required quorum for
                  the index builds to commit
}
This command is useful if the commitQuorum of an active index build is no longer possible or desirable (replica set membership has changed), or potential secondary replication lag has become a greater concern

setProfilingFilterGlobally.help: updates a global filter that determines which operations are eligible for logging/profiling

setUserWriteBlockMode.help: Set whether user write blocking is enabled

shutdown.help: Shuts down the database. Must be run against the admin database and either (1) run from localhost or (2) run while authenticated with the shutdown privilege. If the node is the primary of a replica set, waits up to 'timeoutSecs' for an electable node to be caught up before stepping down. If 'force' is false and no electable node was able to catch up, does not shut down. If the node is in state SECONDARY after the attempted stepdown, any remaining time in 'timeout' is used for quiesce mode, where the database continues to allow operations to run, but directs clients to route new operations to other replica set members.

splitVector.help:
Internal command.
examples:
  { splitVector : "blog.post" , keyPattern:{x:1} , min:{x:10} , max:{x:20}, maxChunkSize:200 }
  maxChunkSize unit in MBs
  May optionally specify 'maxSplitPoints' and 'maxChunkObjects' to avoid traversing the whole chunk
  
  { splitVector : "blog.post" , keyPattern:{x:1} , min:{x:10} , max:{x:20}, force: true }
  'force' will produce one split point even if data is small; defaults to false
NOTE: This command may take a while to run

validate.help:
Validate contents of a namespace by scanning its data structures for correctness.
This is a slow operation.
	Add {full: true} option to do a more thorough check.
	Add {background: true} to validate in the background.
	Add {repair: true} to run repair mode.
	Add {checkBSONConformance: true} to validate BSON documents more thoroughly.
	Add {metadata: true} to only check collection metadata.
Cannot specify both {full: true, background: true}.

validateDBMetadata.help: validateDBMetadata checks that the stored metadata of a database/collection is valid within a particular API version. If 'db' parameter is specified, only runs validation against that database, if not the validation will be run againt all dbs. Similarly if 'collection' parameter is specified, the validation is only run against that collection, if not the validation is run against all collections.

voteCommitIndexBuild.help: Internal intra replica set command to signal to the primary that a member is ready to commit an index build.

waitForFailPoint.help: wait for a fail point to be entered a certain number of times
